metadata.description: LSP plugins for all projects. Claude Code's LSP tool and its automatic diagnostics use them. Each server executable must be on PATH. Each plugin README gives the install commands.

plugins.name: xml-lsp
plugins.description: XML LSP via Eclipse LemMinX; covers DMN, BPMN, SHACL-XML and generic XML/XSD

plugins.name: prolog-lsp
plugins.description: SWI-Prolog LSP via the lsp_server pack (jamesnvc/lsp_server), tracking the default branch

plugins.name: markdown-lsp
plugins.description: Markdown LSP via Marksman: link + reference diagnostics, heading symbols

plugins.name: r-lsp
plugins.description: R LSP via the languageserver package: diagnostics (lintr), definitions, hover

args: p <- Sys.getenv("RENV_PROFILE"); if (!nzchar(p) && file.exists("renv/profile")) p <- c(readLines("renv/profile", n = 1L, warn = FALSE), "")[1L]
r <- if (nzchar(p)) file.path("renv", "profiles", p, "renv", "library") else file.path("renv", "library")
lib <- Sys.glob(c(file.path("rv", "library", v, "*"), file.path(r, "*", paste0("R-", v), "*"), file.path(r, paste0("R-", v), "*")))

plugins.name: bash-lsp
plugins.description: Bash LSP via bash-language-server; shellcheck diagnostics when shellcheck is on PATH
